summary: Voters in Chamraua mostly complain of no development in five years, unemployment and inflation, overflowing drains and unchecked ploughing of government land, while appreciating timely fertiliser and subsidy transfers, a near-complete polytechnic building and some scheme benefits.

positives.english: Fertiliser arrives on time and subsidy goes straight to the bank account
positives.hindi: खाद समय पर मिल रही है, सब्सिडी सीधे खाते में आती है
positives.basis: An unnamed farmer in the Chamraua constituency said fertiliser now arrives on time and subsidy reaches farmers' accounts directly (Amar Ujala, 3 Sep 2026). Single farmer's view reported in the article.

positives.english: The main polytechnic building in Chamraua is complete, classes to start in the new session
positives.hindi: चमरौआ पॉलीटेक्निक का भवन बनकर तैयार, नए सत्र से पढ़ाई होगी
positives.basis: Polytechnic building costing Rs 8.75 crore in Chamraua, Rampur: administrative, main academic and workshop buildings complete; hostels, guard room and generator room still pending (about Rs 6 crore proposal sent). Classes to begin from the new academic session; not yet started (Amar Ujala, 6 May 2026).

positives.english: Some people have received benefits from government schemes
positives.hindi: कुछ लोगों को सरकारी योजनाओं का लाभ मिला है
positives.basis: Some residents in the Chamraua constituency praised state schemes and said they had received benefits; no scheme is named (Amar Ujala, 3 Sep 2026). Weak, general positive.

positives.english: The testing unit building at PHC Chamraua is nearly ready
positives.hindi: पीएचसी चमरौआ में जांच यूनिट का भवन लगभग तैयार है
positives.basis: Block public health unit at PHC Chamraua (one of three units with CHC Milak and CHC Swar) under Ayushman Bharat infrastructure; construction described as nearly complete, planned lab, computer room and two halls, about Rs 39 lakh per unit. As of June 2025 lab technician recruitment was awaited, so this is a building, not a working service. Status may have changed since (Amar Ujala, 7 Jun 2025).

positives.english: Four thieves who stole bags near Chamraua station were arrested by GRP
positives.hindi: चमरौआ स्टेशन पर बैग चोर पकड़े गए, चार जेल भेजे गए
positives.basis: GRP arrested four accused near platform one at Chamraua station on the Rampur-Rudrapur route; cash from the sale of a stolen gold necklace (sold for Rs 72,000) recovered; earrings still with an absconding accused; a fifth accused is being sought (Amar Ujala, 16 Nov 2024). Station named Chamraua, which lies in KC Chamraua per Wikipedia extent. Weak positive: partial recovery only.

negatives.english: No development has happened here in the last five years
negatives.hindi: पिछले पांच साल में यहां कोई विकास नहीं हुआ
negatives.basis: Youths Mushahid and Zakir Ali said no development work happened in the past five years; Zahoor also said there was no development in the constituency (Amar Ujala, 3 Sep 2026). Constituency-level voter statements, no place named.

negatives.english: Unemployment and inflation are a big worry for people
negatives.hindi: बेरोजगारी और महंगाई से लोग परेशान हैं
negatives.basis: Article lists inflation (महंगाई) and unemployment (बेरोजगारी) as main issues for residents and for youth; not attributed to one speaker. Constituency-level, no place named (Amar Ujala, 3 Sep 2026).

negatives.english: Drains in our mohalla are overflowing
negatives.hindi: मोहल्ले में नालियां भरी पड़ी हैं
negatives.basis: Gundu, a resident in the Chamraua constituency, complained of overflowing drains (भरी नालियों) in his locality, and said three complaints filed at the tehsil drew no official inquiry (Amar Ujala, 3 Sep 2026). Locality not named in the source.

negatives.english: The National Public Inter College in Chamraua surrendered its recognition as student numbers kept falling
negatives.hindi: चमरौआ का नेशनल पब्लिक इंटर कॉलेज मान्यता छोड़ गया, छात्र संख्या घटी
negatives.basis: National Public Inter College, Chamraua, Rampur surrendered its recognition (June 2026). District School Inspector Anjali Agarwal said it was because student numbers kept falling; the order by the council secretary covered more than 400 colleges statewide (Amar Ujala, 18 Jun 2026). No student or parent voice in the article; institutional story.

negatives.english: Government land is being ploughed illegally and tehsil complaints get no inquiry
negatives.hindi: सरकारी जमीन पर अवैध जुताई, तहसील की शिकायतों पर जांच नहीं हुई
negatives.basis: Gundu alleged illegal ploughing of government land in the Chamraua constituency and said three complaints filed at the tehsil drew no official visit or inquiry (Amar Ujala, 3 Sep 2026). Allegation by a resident, not verified by officials; land not named.

notes: Identity confirmed via Wikipedia (Chamraua Assembly constituency): AC 35, Rampur district, reserved status None; extent: KC Matkhera of Suar Tehsil; KCs Saidnagar and Chamraua of Rampur Tehsil. Wikipedia infobox Hindi name is चमरव्वा (apparent typo); Amar Ujala uses चमरौआ and चमरौवा; official ECI Hindi spelling still to be checked. Region set to Rohilkhand (Rampur division). Evidence is thin: only one constituency-level voter article (Amar Ujala, 3 Sep 2026) backs the voter complaints, and that article is cited for four negatives and two positives. Negatives 1, 2, 3 and 5 are constituency-level or unnamed-locality statements, so only negative 4 (NPIC, Chamraua town) counts as AC-specific by the place-name rule; the brief's target of 3 is not met. Negatives 3 and 5 both come from Gundu and repeat the tehsil-complaint point. Positives 3 (PHC unit) and 5 (GRP arrests) are weak and dated. No sourced complaints about water, electricity, roads, sugarcane or hospital services specific to Chamraua were found. Places rejected: Surajpur village (Patwai area, Amar Ujala 28 Mar 2026) because the article names no constituency; Pranpur village (Saidnagar block, Kosi water report not found); Patrika Agapur Road (2018, Rampur city, not this AC); Milak CHC (Milak is a separate area). Field check suggested: Saidnagar and Matkhera drains and roads, PHC Chamraua lab staffing, opening of Chamraua polytechnic classes, sugarcane dues in the area, the NPIC Chamraua closure, and the Gundu tehsil complaints.

round2.changes: Opened all 5 article URLs and Wikipedia identity page; all open and support the core facts. Removed unsupported claims: fertiliser shortages had eased (P), Mahfooz and MLA absence/unfulfilled promises (N1), youths listing education (N2). Corrected: NPIC recognition surrendered, not revoked; PHC unit list (CHC Milak, CHC Swar, PHC Chamraua); GRP recovery detail; drains wording to overflowing; polytechnic main buildings complete with hostels pending. Re-ranked positives: fertiliser/subsidy 1, polytechnic 2, schemes 3, PHC unit 4, GRP 5. ac_specific_negatives reduced 5 to 1 (only NPIC names a place inside the AC). Five further searches (water, roads, power, sugarcane, Saidnagar drains, Amar Ujala Chamraua) found no new Chamraua-specific sourced items; Surajpur/Patwai waterlogging article still rejected (no constituency named).
